blessings.name: Steady Flame
blessings.text: The Hero's special comes back 20% sooner.

blessings.name: Lamp Oil
blessings.text: Towers and the Keep mend 2% of their health a second between waves.

blessings.name: Second Wind
blessings.text: The Hero gets up 40% sooner after a fall.

blessings.name: Tide's Gift
blessings.text: 30% more gold from kills, but the Keep has 15% less health.

blessings.name: Thick Fog
blessings.text: Monsters move 15% faster, and you earn 25% more gold.
